summary: Mergeable with minor issues related to maintainability and documentation.

issues.description: The patch introduces a complex random state management system, which may be hard to understand and maintain.
The patch uses a different variable name (`seeds`) for the random state, which is slightly inconsistent with the rest of the code.
The patch does not include additional tests to verify the correctness of the random state management system.
The patch does not update the docstring to reflect the changes in the random state management system.
